title: Work panel: make Urgent (P0/P1) its own view tab before Dependencies instead of an embedded mini strip
outcome: Work panel: make Urgent (P0/P1) its own view tab before Dependencies instead of an embedded mini strip
acceptance: The Work panel's view switcher shows an "Urgent" view button immediately before "Dependencies". Selecting it shows the P0/P1 items that the Urgent strip shows today, from the same rows and the same urgency rule, with the same select-to-details behaviour. The embedded Urgent strip above the Dependencies graph is removed, so urgent items appear in exactly one place.

The default view and the behaviour of the Dependencies, Hierarchy, Labels, Table and Memories views are unchanged. Paging, local filters, selection and expanded details keep working in every view, including Urgent. An empty Urgent view shows a short empty state.

Behavioural UI tests (vitest) cover: the Urgent button sits before Dependencies; selecting it lists an unlinked P0 and a held P1 and opens their details; the strip is no longer rendered above Dependencies; the existing view tests still pass, updated only where they assert on the removed strip's placement. `cd ui && npx tsc --noEmit` is clean, and the whole vitest suite passes on the author run.
